objectpackh5memorialRumor0.text: Troops shrunk or downgraded by some spell needn't lose heart. One trip to the H5 Memorial Advanced Exchange turns them back to normal, and it doesn't cost a copper.

objectpackh5memorialRumor1.text: They say the H5 Memorial Advanced Magic Academy never charges tuition; it only checks whether your school skills are good enough—the higher the skill, the more advanced the spells you can learn.

objectpackh5memorialRumor2.text: Legend has it the H5 Memorial Shrine is held by a full army. Whoever beats the garrison and then returns with upgraded troops of levels 1 to 7 from a single faction will permanently learn that faction's ultimate ability.

objectpackh5memorialRumor3.text: A hero who learned Nature's Luck at the H5 Memorial Shrine never rolls the dice: every blow his troops strike is a lucky one.
